p.src: That is why dollar-cost averaging is a risk-reduction tool. p.src: The Annual Assignment

u.src: The Annual Assignment
en: The Annual Assignment

p.src: A person who wants to become an investor should not begin by asking for stock tips. A better beginning is to build a simple research habit that lasts at least a year.

u.src: A person who wants to become an investor should not begin by asking for stock tips. A better beginning is to build a simple research habit that lasts at least a year.
en: A person who wants to become an investor should not begin by asking for stock tips. A better beginning is to build a simple research habit that lasts at least a year.

p.src: Create a table of companies. Once a month, update their prices. Add basic notes. Record what you believed before and what changed afterward. Add a dollar-cost averaging column and calculate what would have happened if you had invested a fixed amount at each interval.

u.src: Create a table of companies. Once a month, update their prices. Add basic notes. Record what you believed before and what changed afterward. Add a dollar-cost averaging column and calculate what would have happened if you had invested a fixed amount at each interval.
en: Create a table of companies. Once a month, update their prices. Add basic notes. Record what you believed before and what changed afterward. Add a dollar-cost averaging column and calculate what would have happened if you had invested a fixed amount at each interval.

p.src: Do not ask someone else how the table must look. Make one. Improve it. Break it. Rebuild it. The point is not the elegance of the spreadsheet. The point is the training of judgment.

u.src: Do not ask someone else how the table must look. Make one. Improve it. Break it. Rebuild it. The point is not the elegance of the spreadsheet. The point is the training of judgment.
en: Do not ask someone else how the table must look. Make one. Improve it. Break it. Rebuild it. The point is not the elegance of the spreadsheet. The point is the training of judgment.

p.src: Then add a second habit: each month, identify one more company that may have long-term growth characteristics. Search. Read. Compare. Write down why it might be worth studying and what would prove the idea wrong.

u.src: Then add a second habit: each month, identify one more company that may have long-term growth characteristics. Search. Read. Compare. Write down why it might be worth studying and what would prove the idea wrong.
en: Then add a second habit: each month, identify one more company that may have long-term growth characteristics. Search. Read. Compare. Write down why it might be worth studying and what would prove the idea wrong.

p.src: After twelve months, the investor will not merely have a table. He will have a record of attention. He will have watched prices move without needing to react to every movement. He will have experienced the gap between opinion and evidence. He will have become less frightened by unfamiliar documents, less dependent on other people’s conclusions, and more capable of asking precise questions.
